description: Power BI's native matrix wasn't built for complex reporting — teams often have to simplify the report, accept limited formatting control, or spend extra time building around the default experience. AtaytisTech Matrix gives report creators a more configurable way to build advanced matrix and table-style reports with greater control over layout, formatting, interaction, context, and presentation. It is designed for teams that need polished, interactive reports that are easier to build, easier to review, and smoother for viewers to use. Why Ataytis Matrix? Key features: Customizable user toolbar with search, row counts, density selection, expand and collapse actions, copy mode, export buttons, notes, highlighting tools, custom labels, icons, and styling. Flexible matrix layouts and hierarchy controls, including compact, outline, and tabular layouts, values as columns or rows, default expansion control, repeated row headers by level, child counts, spacing, indentation, and hierarchy icon settings. Advanced grid, header, and formatting control for headers, values, subtotals, grand totals, alternate rows, borders, fonts, colors, number formats, blanks, display units, wrapping, alignment, column sizing, and column order.
